title: 第一卷 第29章 谁赞成，谁反对！
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
海河帮总舵，聚义厅。

    空气里弥漫着一股说不清道不明的燥热。

    不是天热，是心热。

    长条桌案两边，坐满了人。

    堂主、元老、香主，黑压压一片脑袋。

    桌子正中间，摆着一只还在滴血的麻袋，那是吴正明的脑袋。

    眼珠子瞪得溜圆，像是看见了什么不可思议的东西。

    陆川坐在下首，手里拿着把茶壶，也不倒水就那么晃悠着听响。

    赵海柱坐在主位，手里盘着两颗核桃，盘得嘎啦嘎啦响。

    “川子昨晚那一手，漂亮。”

    赵海柱咧嘴笑，露出一口白牙，“漕运商会这次脸都被打肿了，沈玉楼现在估计正喝参汤吊命呢。”

    底下有人跟着笑，有人附和。

    “那是，川哥那是神威！”

    “漕运商会算个屁，以后咱们海河帮就是津门老大！”

    气氛正热烈。

    突然，角落里传来一声冷哼。

    “哼！”

    声音不大，但在安静的大厅里显得格外刺耳。

    笑声戛然而止。

    所有人的目光都转了过去。

    说话的是个干瘦老头，留着两撇老鼠胡，眼睛眯成一条缝。

    渡水堂堂主，宋文峰。

    他旁边坐着听潮堂副堂主王奎，还有几个平时就不太对付的元老。

    “帮主，高兴得太早了吧。”

    宋文峰慢悠悠地站起来，也不看赵海柱，一双绿豆眼死死盯着陆川。

    “高兴？”

    赵海柱手里的核桃停了，“老宋，你什么意思？”

    “什么意思？”

    宋文峰皮笑肉不笑，“我是替帮主担心。”

    “咱们海河帮在津门混了几十年，靠的是什么？靠的是兄弟义气，靠的是知根知底！”

    他猛地一抬手，指着陆川。

    “这小子，是个什么来路？”

    大厅里瞬间安静下来，落针可闻。

    陆川还在晃茶壶，眼皮都没抬一下。

    赵海柱脸色沉了下来：“老宋，陆川是我兄弟，也是帮里的镇涛堂副堂主，你问这话是在质疑我的眼光？”

    “不敢。”

    宋文峰拱了拱手，语气却更冲了，“帮主眼光自然没问题。可这小子，太邪乎了。”

    “半年前，他还是三号码头的一个臭苦力，扛大包都费劲。”

    “半年后，他就能单手捏死明劲巅峰的吴正明？”

    宋文峰往前跨了一步，声音拔高数倍，“明劲巅峰啊！那是吴正明！八极拳传人！在北平武行里那也是响当当的人物！”

    “一个苦力，哪怕天天吃龙肉，半年时间能练成暗劲宗师？”

    这话一出，原本看热闹的人群里，起了骚动。

    确实。

    太不合理了！

    练武不是蒸馒头，撒把水就能熟。

    那是实打实熬时间、熬筋骨、熬气血的活儿。

    半年时间，从普通人到暗劲？

    除非他是神仙转世。

    “宋堂主说得对。”

    听潮堂的王奎也跟着站了起来，阴阳怪气地接茬，“咱们海河帮虽然不讲究出身，但也不能什么阿猫阿狗都往核心层里塞吧？”

    “万一......我是说万一，这小子是别的帮派派来的细作呢？”

    “或者是洋人的走狗？”

    “图谋不轨”四个字，像块大石头，砸进了平静的水面。

    几个原本就嫉妒陆川升官快的堂主，眼神开始闪烁。

    陆川太强了。

    强得让人害怕！

    如果他是自己人，那是海河帮的刀。

    如果他不是自己人，那就是悬在所有人脖子上的刀。

    “放屁！”

    赵海柱猛地一拍桌子，实木桌子裂开一道缝。
content_en:
The chief rudder of the Haihe Gang, Juyi Hall.

    There was an indescribable heat in the air.

    It's not the weather that's hot, it's the heart that's hot.

    There were people sitting on both sides of the long table.

    The heads of the hall masters, elders, and incense masters were all covered in darkness.

    In the middle of the table, there was a sack still dripping with blood. It was Wu Zhengming's head.

    His eyes were wide open, as if he had seen something incredible.

    Lu Chuan was sitting at the bottom, holding a teapot in his hand, just swaying around and listening to the sound without pouring water.

    Zhao Haizhu sat at the main seat, holding two walnuts in his hand, making a rattling sound.

    "Kawako's move last night was beautiful."

    Zhao Haizhu grinned, showing his white teeth, "The Water Transport Chamber of Commerce's face was swollen this time, and Shen Yulou is probably drinking ginseng soup to die."

    Some people below laughed, some echoed.

    "That's right, Brother Chuan, that's divine power!"

    "The Water Transport Chamber of Commerce is nothing, from now on our Haihe Gang will be the boss of Jinmen!"

    The atmosphere is lively.

    Suddenly, a cold snort came from the corner.

    "Hmph!"

    The sound was not loud, but it was particularly harsh in the quiet hall.

    The laughter stopped abruptly.

    Everyone's eyes turned away.

    The speaker was a skinny old man with a rat beard and narrowed eyes.

    The leader of Dushui Hall is Song Wenfeng.

    Sitting next to him were Wang Kui, the deputy leader of Tingchao Hall, and several elders who were usually not easy to deal with.

    "Gang Leader, it's too early to be happy."

    Song Wenfeng stood up slowly without looking at Zhao Haizhu, and stared at Lu Chuan with his green bean eyes.

    "Happy?"

    Zhao Haizhu stopped holding the walnuts in his hand, "Old Song, what do you mean?"

    "What do you mean?"

    Song Wenfeng smiled softly, "I'm worried about the gang leader."

    "Our Haihe Gang has been in Jinmen for decades. What do we rely on? We rely on brotherly loyalty and knowing everything!"

    He suddenly raised his hand and pointed at Lu Chuan.

    "Where does this kid come from?"

    The hall instantly became quiet, and you could hear a needle drop.

    Lu Chuan was still shaking the teapot without even raising his eyelids.

    Zhao Haizhu's face darkened: "Old Song, Lu Chuan is my brother and the deputy leader of the Zhentao Hall in the gang. Are you questioning my vision by asking this?"

    "Don't dare."

    Song Wenfeng cupped his hands, but his tone became more aggressive, "Of course the gang leader's vision is fine. But this kid is too evil."

    "Six months ago, he was a stinky coolie at Pier 3, struggling to carry big bags."

    "In half a year, he will be able to crush Wu Zhengming, who is at the peak of his power, to death with one hand?"

    Song Wenfeng took a step forward, his voice rising several times higher, "The peak of Ming Jin! That's Wu Zhengming! The successor of Bajiquan! He is also a well-known figure in the martial arts in Peking!"

    "A coolie, even if he eats dragon meat every day, can he become an Anjin master in half a year?"

    As soon as these words came out, there was a commotion in the crowd that was originally watching the excitement.

    really.

    How unreasonable!

    Martial arts training is not about steaming steamed buns, which can be cooked by just pouring some water on them.

    That is a real job that requires time, muscles, and blood.

    In half a year, from ordinary person to dark power?

    Unless he is the reincarnation of a god.

    "Hall Master Song is right."

    Wang Kui from Tingchao Hall also stood up and continued in a strange tone, "Although our Haihe Gang doesn't pay attention to family background, we can't stuff all the cats and dogs into the core layer, right?"

    "What if... I mean what if, this kid is a spy sent by another gang?"

    "Or is he a lackey of the foreigners?"

    The four words "with evil intentions" were like a big stone smashed into the calm water.

    The eyes of several hall masters who were originally jealous of Lu Chuan's rapid promotion began to flicker.

    Lu Chuan is too strong.

    Scaryly strong!

    If he is one of our own, it is the sword of the Haihe Gang.

    If he is not one of our own, it is a knife hanging on everyone's neck.

    "Fart!"

    Zhao Haizhu slammed the table, causing a crack in the solid wood table.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 29 Who is in favor and who is against!
